[b]Dear Leader[/b]
[sub]Act 1: Get Happy[/sub]]
As the President of New Westmore, Holt is forbidden from driving his own car in the interest of protecting his safety 24/7. Everywhere he goes, he must be escorted by agents of the Federal Police, and must sit in a car that has been fortified just enough to stop a bullet from entering the back of his head.

On this particular night, he did not care for laws or conventions. He was itching to get behind the wheel of a car, to get away from the stress of Parliament on his own terms and just enjoy a night out in Dalesburg, not as a leader, but as a common man; another face in the endless swirl of the capital's booming nightlife.

A car is a symbol of pure freedom, of unabated joy and bliss. A car, a godsend to the beleaguered president, sick of dealing with the increasing hostility of the Oceanice Republic, the rampant warmongering and nuclear-powered meddling of the THEP and the plethora of international and domestic problems and issues he just couldn't give two sh*ts about.

He snoops around in the car park under Parliament House, looking for the vehicle his pair of stolen keys is attached to. Ensuring that he isn't spotted by the cameras or by the prowling guards, he shifts from car to car, sticking his key into their doors and trying to twist it to see if it's the right one.

Eventually, he finds the right vehicle. His keys correspond to a black Zagame 450, a sleek coupe like creature built by the nation's finest in automotive. He quietly opens the door and slips inside.

His hands curl around the wheel of the 450. Its leather-bound cover feels natural in his hands.

It just feels right.

He sticks the key into its ignition and twists it. The car purrs to life, and before he can allow the guards to notice, he puts the car into drive and starts making his way to the exit of the car park.

...

[i]"And now on XIV14's Golden Oldies: Judy Garland's 'Get Happy!'"[/i]

The bright lights of Dalesburg shine above Holt's head. They are all different shades and colours of all kinds; a brilliant rainbow of life and activity in the murky dark of the sleeping world. 

Holt never gets to appreciate this side of Westmorian life as the President from his office in the Houses of Parliament. Until now, he was forever cursed to be detached from the people he is in charge of; so close but yet so far.

This is the society he represents. And he couldn't be more proud of it.

[i]"Forget your troubles c'mon get happy, you better chase all your cares away..."[/i]

He passes the Federal Police headquarters. If only they knew the man they were supposed to be watching around the clock had evaded their iron grasp.

[i]Ah, it couldn't hurt.[/i] Holt decides to slam his foot down on the accelerator, and the car obliges. It picks up speed and whisks the President away from the sleeping den of his guardians.

[i]"We're wading across the river; wash your sins in the tide. It's all so peaceful on the other side..."[/i]

The 450 shoots past the Eden Cowrie Station at breakneck speed. In his mind, Holt is reliving his days of paddock-bashing on his family's farm in the fields of West Elroa, with his father and his brother in tow.

In the moment, he is a hooligan; a dumb teenager having dangerous fun in a car he doesn't own.

[i]"The sun is shining; c'mon get happy, the lord is waiting to take your hand..."[/i]

He takes a sharp right and enters the Eden Street Mall. The bright lights of Dalesburg shimmer and dazzle the President.

This is his nation.

These are his people.

These are the lives he protects.

This is his effort in action.

This is the life beyond his office.

And it is oh-so... [i]intoxicating.[/i]

[i]"Shout hallelujah; c'mon get happy, gеt ready for the judgemеnt day..."[/i]

Holt stops at a pub in the mall and gets out of his car.

He doesn't emerge from the building until just before midnight.

[i]"Get ready for the judgement day..."[/i]

...
[sub]read with https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AVutrPKcGgE in the background[/sub]

An inebriated Holt stumbles out of the pub and towards his car. A crowd of drunken comrades cheer him on as he inches closer towards his vehicle.

Everything is an incomprehensible mess of colours and sounds. He has drunken enough alcohol to knock a lesser man dead.

He is in no state to drive a car, but that didn't stop him from paddock-bashing in a clapped-out Hernand in his youth.

Without a second thought, Holt crawls into the Zagame 450 and drives off. His car wobbles around on the street, like it too has become drunk.

His radio is playing some 80s synthwave song. The music sounds like angels singing to him from high above.

He does a vague turn to the right, heading to the junction between Codroe Road and Eden Street on the way to the district of Ness.

Off in the distance, the Bell Tower begins to toll, signalling the beginning of the midnight hour. It too becomes an incomprehensible mess of noise to Holt, drowning out the sound of his music and the purr of his car's engine.

In his intoxication, Holt fails to notice the red traffic light in a timely manner. He overshoots his entry into the junction and brings his car to a stop in the dead center of the road, thinking that he has rectified the issue and that all is well.

In the mess of the sensory overload that has overpowered him, a single stimulus cuts through the mess like a knife.

A white light.

And a horn.

Holt slowly turns his head around to face the window to the right of his seat. Out of the window, he sees the stairway to Heaven.

God has come to claim His child.

...

[i]"Oh f*ck! F*ck, f*ck, f*ck!"[/i]

Darren stumbles out of his wrecked truck. He is unscathed; the same cannot be said for the twisted mass of black metal and plastic wrapped around the front of his vehicle.

He approaches the ruined car and shouts. "Hello?! Are you okay?! Do you need help?"

Through the cracked tinted windows, he sees the unmistakable scarlet hue of blood splattered on the windshield on the driver's side.

He reaches for his phone, and calls for emergency services. "Sh*t! Hold on, I'm gonna help you out of there!"

Darren runs towards the car and tries to tear the obliterated windshield off. He manages to pull it aside, and all of a sudden he is hit by an overwhelming stench of copper. He stares down at the seats of the car, and in that moment the gravity of the situation finally impacts him at full force.

He falls to his knees on the crumpled bonnet. "Oh no..."

In front of the distraught truck driver rests a mangled corpse, torn in half at the waist by the impact and mutilated by the compression of metal against human flesh. Although bloody and bruised, the corpse's face is still as recognisable as day.

Darren has killed the President.[/spoiler]

[quote=alkiragunya;59777540][Spoiler=Arco do totem perdido-Chapter 8]
[i]Eu perdi para um dedo, UM [u]DEDO[/u], ENTENDE?![/i]
Gillut apontou para Tjilpi o dedo indicador, o corvo apenas abaixou a mão do paciente, com calma falou:
[i]Se não tivesse sido tão arrogante isso não teria acontecido você sabe.[/i]
Dulbara, que estava deitado na outra rede, não por precisar, mas apenas pois queria, falou.
[i]Hmph, você também foi derrotado não pode falar de mim...[/i]
Gillut se defendeu, em seguida, Dulbara o respondeu.
[i]Huh, pelo menos não perdi para [b]UM[/b] dedo.[/i]
[i]E EU...[/i]
[i]Pelo amor de Waadang se acalmem, vocês dois foram feridos em batalha e agora estão vendo quem foi mais humilhado...VOCÊS DOIS FORAM![/i]
Tjilpi demanda silêncio, já estava cansado de ouvir as brigas dos dois, eles se calaram, exceto Gillut que murmurou apenas para si:
[i]Eu ainda vou vencer aquele cara.[/i]
Amarunga estava pegando um camelo para viajem, ele não carregava muito, apenas suas vestes e uma bolsa para suprimentos, ele se despediu dizendo:
[i]Eu logo retornarei com notícias deles.[/i]
Amarunga começou a ir em direção de Nariburu, o plano era simples, mas decisivo, ele chegou a Nariburu, lá fora haviam algumas rochas, algumas com símbolos esculpidos de diabos da tasmânia e camelos, Amarunga silenciosamente os pegou e pôs nas vestes.
[i]Isso parece importante, ou pelo menos, útil.[/i] ao pôr uma das pedras nas mãos sentiu um pequeno latejamento de dentro da rocha, ele imediatamente reconheceu [i]EXPLOSIVO![/i]
E jogou a rocha na entrada da caverna, várias pedras desmoronaram e taparam a entrada, Amarunga ficou pálido por ter chamado atenção demais.
[i]Ora ora ora, veja só, uma lagartixa curiosa querendo ver onde não deve. [/i]
Uma figura zombou lá de cima, ele apontou diretamente para Amarunga, ele tinha uma máscara branca com olhos fechados negros e um sorriso sutil, a máscara era branca e por trás dela ele usava um capuz terroso, suas vestes eram uma túnica marrom amarelada batida, suas mãos tinham luvas brancas empoeiradas, e na cintura tinha um cinto de couro de serpente que tinha várias machadinhas.
[i]Procurando meu mestre ora? Pois bem, saiba que Tjuwungu NÃO está aqui...[/i]
Amarunga estava nervoso, ele olhou para o homem e tentou aumentar o tom de voz para parecer severo:
[i]QUEM É VOCÊ, e como sabe que estava aqui?[/I]
[i]Ohohoho, vocês conselheiros parecem esquecer de uma coisa, toda magia deixa rastros, eu só segui os seus, a propósito, que rude de minha parte não me apresentar, me chamo Munderro, aprendiz de Tjuwungu, o mesmo que os atacou há 2 dias, sim o mesmo que reconstruiu o totem Purinina com pedaços do Murkitilpa. [/i]
Munderro falou em um tom calmo e relaxado, mas Amarunga não esperou o purinina dizer mais nada, apenas atacou, levantando várias rochas próximas e as jogando contra Munderro, o qual desviou de forma fluída e elegante, como se estivesse nem tentando.
[i]Ohoho que rude, pois bem então, deixe eu me apresentar.[/i]
Munderro pôs as mãos na cintura e então saltou, uma aura negra dominou sua mão e o machado que suas mãos estavam sobre.
Amarunga se preparou em uma postura defensiva, transformando seu corpo em pedrapara blindagem, o purinina lançou uma das machadinhas contra Amarunga, ela rebateu na pele rochosa e caiu no chão.
[i]Oh, que tolice que a minha, esqueci disso...pois bem, não tenho muito tempo para lutar com você, vamos terminar isso logo.[/i]
Munderro sorriu por trás de sua máscara, ele então disse enquanto passava o braço sobre a testa:
[i]Lâmina degenerada.[/i]
Seu antebraço brilhou em uma aura escura afiada que ia até a ponta de sua mão desde o cotovelo, ele saltou para Amarunga que bloqueou o ataque com os dois braços, mas logo sentiu sua armadura se quebrando.
 [i]O...oque[/i]
Ele gaguejou, em resposta, Munderro levantou os braços como se declamasse algo:
[i]Lâmina degenerada, uma técnica sombria, que consiste em canalizar a energia no antebraço como uma lâmina, é capaz de cortar muitas coisas diferentes, incluindo, outras formas de magia.[/i]
Ele apontou para Amarunga, que perguntou:
[i]E por que você me diria isso?![/i]
Munderro apenas deu de ombros e respondeu:
[i]Pois, ora, não é essa sua missão? A minha era apenas de patrulhar, não impedir espionagem ou coleta de informações.[/i]
Ele então suspirou e preparou-se em postura de luta, parecia meio, relaxado demais, Amarunga decidiu atacar, transformando a mão em rocha, o Purinina segurou seu soco em frente à sua máscara e disse.
[i]Lento demais, tente denovo.[/i]
E foi outro soco, dessa vez também bloqueado, na barriga, ele se recuou com uma acrobacia, e novamente o desafiou a atacar, novamente, sem fazer o primeiro ataque.
[i]Oque você quer.[/i]
Amarunga rugiu, Munderro riu novamente.
[i]Ohoho, seus primeiros dois ataques foram absolutamente vergonhosos, estou lhe dando outra chance de atacar e se redimir.[/i]
Amarunga novamente avançou, com um soco mais cheio de energia, Munderro porém dessa vez desviou, ágil e elegante, retirou um machado maior que estava escondido em suas costas e então disse.
[i]Muito bom devo dizer, é oque espera do poder de um conselheiro, PARTIÇÃO ATTERRADORA![/i]
Ele golpeou o ar em direção a Amarunga que criou a projeção de um "slash" vermelho , ele arregalou os olhos de surpresa, e então foi atingido e atirado contra um obelisco rochoso, que caiu sobre ele, mas antes de cair, ativou Warlutja, e então escalou as rochas para fazer um ataque surpresa.
[i]Onde está...lagartixa, onde está.[/i]
Ele zombou procurando, mas então Amarunga o atacou por trás, pelas costas com um soco na lateral de suas costelas, Munderro foi jogado, mas se recuperou rápido.
[i]Agh, que deselegante...mas um bom uso de sua técnica...  [/i]
Então avançou novamente, agora com o machado imbuído em energia escura, Amarunga agiu rápido e formou uma clava de rocha das mãos e ambas armas se colidiram, criando um impacto devastador para ambos, que foram jogados para trás, Amarunga pensou por um momento:
[i]Ele é poderoso demais, mas o tempo está passando, seria sensato ativar Warlutja e recuar.[/i]
Do outro lado, o adversário pensou:
[i]Oooh, ele é poderoso, tem a técnica, e sabe a manusear...mais ou menos, ele não vai terminar essa luta, se não recuar agora irá o fazer logo em outra oportunidade, isso não será um problema no entanto, é sensato recuar agora, 1 voltar para aquele velho(Tjuwungu) logo se não ele ficará mais irritante do que já é, e 2, meu braço já está puxando, eu poderia usar novamente a lâmina degenerada, mas seria um custo desnecessário, hm, já sei.
[/i][b]dissipação[/b]. 
Munderro disse, então uma nuvem de areia o engolindo, após ela se desfazer, já não estava mais lá, Amarunga não perdeu tempo, ativou Warlutja e rastejou de volta a estrada, voltando a Towurunga, cansado e meio cambaleante, mas ainda são, ele chegou para Balunji e falou, com o tom de voz arrastado:
[i]Eles já saíram...trouxe alguns objetos do ritual...e Tjuwungu, o nome do inimigo, não está sozinho...Munderro é o nome de outro seguidor...[/i]
Balunji segurou Amarunga, mesmo que não tivesse caindo, queria precaver, ele respondeu:
[i]Eu entendo, agora, descanse.[/i]
----------------------------------------
[i]I lost to a finger, [u]ONE [/u]FINGER, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?![/i]
Gillut pointed his index finger at Tjilpi, the crow just lowered the patient's hand and calmly said:
[i]If you hadn't been so arrogant this wouldn't have happened, you know.[/i]
Dulbara, who was lying in the other hammock, not because he needed to, but just because he wanted to, spoke.
[i]Hmph, you were also defeated, you can't talk about me...[/i]
Gillut defended himself, then Dulbara answered him. [i]Huh, at least I didn't lose to  [b]ONE[/b] finger[/i]
[i]AND ME...[/i]
[i]For the love of Waadang, calm down, you two were injured in battle and now you're seeing who was more humiliated...YOU TWO WERE![/i]
Tjilpi demanded silence, he was tired of hearing the two fight, they fell silent, except Gillut who muttered only to himself:
[i]I'm still going to beat that guy.[/i]
Amarunga was taking a camel for the trip, he didn't carry much, just his clothes and a bag for supplies, he said goodbye saying:
[i]I'll be back soon with news of them.[/i]
Amarunga started heading towards Nariburu, the plan was simple, but decisive, he arrived at Nariburu, outside there were some rocks, some with carved symbols of Tasmanian devils and camels, Amarunga silently picked them up and put them in his clothes.
[i]This seems important, or at least useful.[/i] As he put one of the stones in his hands he felt a small throbbing inside the rock, he immediately recognized it [i]EXPLOSIVE![/i]
And he threw the rock at the entrance of the cave, several stones crumbled and blocked the entrance, Amarunga turned pale for having drawn too much attention.
[i]Well well well, look at that, a curious lizard wanting to see where it shouldn't.[/i]
A figure mocked from above, he pointed directly at Amarunga, he had a white mask with closed black eyes and a subtle smile, the mask was white and behind it he wore an earthy hood, his clothes were a worn yellowish brown tunic, his hands had dusty white gloves, and around his waist he had a snakeskin belt that had several small axes.
[i]Looking for my master now? Well, know that Tjuwungu is NOT here...[/i]
Amarunga was nervous, he looked at the man and tried to raise his voice to sound stern:
[i]WHO ARE YOU, and how do you know I was here?[/i]
[i]Ohohoho, you counselors seem to forget one thing, all magic leaves traces, I only followed yours, by the way, how rude of me not to introduce myself, my name is Munderro, apprentice of Tjuwungu, the same one who attacked them 2 days ago, yes, the same one who rebuilt the Purinina totem with pieces of Murkitilpa.[/i]
Munderro spoke in a calm and relaxed tone, but Amarunga did not wait for the purinina to say anything else, he just attacked, lifting several nearby rocks and throwing them at Munderro, who dodged them fluidly and elegantly, as if he was not even trying. [i]Ohoho how rude, well then, let me introduce myself.[/i]
Munderro put his hands on his waist and then jumped, a black aura dominated his hand and the axe that his hands were on.
Amarunga prepared himself in a defensive posture, transforming his body into stone for armor, the purinina threw one of the small axes at Amarunga, it bounced off the rocky skin and fell to the ground.
[i]Oh, how foolish of me, I forgot about that... well, I don't have much time to fight you, let's finish this quickly.[/i]
Munderro smiled behind his mask, he then said as he passed his arm over his forehead:
[i]Degenerate blade.[/i]
His forearm shone in a sharp dark aura that went all the way to the tip of his hand from the elbow, he jumped towards Amarunga who blocked the attack with both arms, but soon felt his armor breaking. [i]W...what?[/i]
He stuttered, in response, Munderro raised his arms as if declaiming something:
[i]Degenerate blade, a dark technique, which consists of channeling energy in the forearm like a blade, is capable of cutting many different things, including other forms of magic.[/i]
He pointed at Amarunga, who asked:
[i]And why would you tell me that?![/i]
Munderro just shrugged and replied:
[i]Well, isn't that your mission? Mine was just to patrol, not prevent espionage or information gathering.[/i]
He then sighed and prepared himself in a fighting stance, he seemed a little too relaxed, Amarunga decided to attack, turning his hand into rock, Purinina held his punch in front of his mask and said.
[i]Too slow, try again.[/i]
And it was another punch, this time also blocked, in the belly, he retreated with an acrobatic acrobatics, and again challenged him to attack, again, without making the first attack.
[i]What do you want.[/i]
Amarunga roared, Munderro laughed again.
[i]Ohoho, your first two attacks were absolutely shameful, I'm giving you another chance to attack and redeem yourself.[/i]
Amarunga again advanced, with a punch fuller of energy, Munderro however this time dodged it, agile and elegant, he removed a larger axe that was hidden in his back and then said.
[i]Very good I must say, it's what you expect from the power of a counselor, TERRIFYING PARTITION![/i]
He struck the air towards Amarunga that created the projection of a red "slash", he widened his eyes in surprise, and then was hit and thrown against a rocky obelisk, which fell on him, but before falling, he activated Warlutja, and then climbed the rocks to make a surprise attack.
[i]Where is... lizard, where is it.[/i]
He mocked searching, but then Amarunga attacked him from behind, from behind with a punch to the side of his ribs, Munderro was thrown, but recovered quickly. [i]Agh, how inelegant... but a good use of his technique... [/i]
Then he advanced again, now with the axe imbued with dark energy, Amarunga acted quickly and formed a rock club in his hands and both weapons collided, creating a devastating impact for both, who were thrown back, Amarunga thought for a moment:
[i]He is too powerful, but time is running out, it would be wise to activate Warlutja and retreat.[/i]
On the other side, the opponent thought:
[i]Oooh, he is powerful, he has the technique, and he knows how to handle it... more or less, he will not finish this fight, if he does not retreat now he will do it soon another time, that will not be a problem however, it is wise to retreat now, 1. go back to that old man (Tjuwungu) soon or he will become more annoying than he already is, and 2. my arm is already pulling, I could use the degenerate blade again, but it would be a cost unnecessary, hm, I know.
[/i][b]dissipation[/b].
Munderro said, then a cloud of sand swallowed him, after it dispersed, he was no longer there, Amarunga wasted no time, activated Warlutja and crawled back to the road, returning to Towurunga, tired and half staggering, but still healthy, he arrived at Balunji and spoke, with a drawn-out tone of voice:
[i]They have already left... I brought some ritual objects... and Tjuwungu, the name of the enemy, is not alone... Munderro is the name of another follower...[/i]
Balunji held Amarunga, even though he was not falling, he wanted to be careful, he replied:
[i]I understand, now, rest.[/i]

[i]"...O Lord, please give eternal rest and everlasting joy to Andrew. Lord, hear our prayer..."[/i]

Joel arises from his seat and hands the Bible to Marcus. "Please take a seat, Mr. Vanderbilt."

Marcus places his cane on the table and takes a seat in Holt's chair.

Marcus places the Bible on his chest.

"Repeat after me:"

[i]I, Marcus Vanderbilt, do solemnly swear that I will represent and lead New Westmore with her best interests in mind; that I will forever and always place the needs of my people above my own; that I will discharge my duty with care and with due diligence; that as leader, I will uphold Westmore's values of a democratic, just and equal society for all; that I will perform my presidential duty to the best of my ability. So help me God.[/i]

"From this point forward, you are now the official President of New Westmore."

Marcus pumps his fist. "Bloody awesome."

[i]"Ahem.[/i] Be respectful, Marcus." Joel glares at his friend.

...
